cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): [MRT-007] answers question 1: law 2017-020 bars transfers without sufficient protection. It allows one-off transfers on consent, and [MRT-001] sets an authorisation request only for hosts off the authority's list, so question 2 is open. [MRT-006] gives the published list, and [MRT-008] the ratification.
